quizzes.lessonTitle: On an Australian job: claims, controls and records
quizzes.title: Ozone and Hydroxyl Generators: What the Evidence Says — Knowledge Check

questions.questionText: What is the Australian workplace exposure limit for ozone?
options: An 8-hour average of 1 ppm
A peak limitation of 0.1 ppm (0.2 mg/m³), not to be exceeded at any time
There is no Australian limit for ozone
5 ppm for up to 15 minutes, four times a day

questions.questionText: What happens to the ozone limit when the Workplace Exposure Limits (WEL) replace the WES on 1 December 2026?
options: It is removed
It doubles
The July 2025 WEL list keeps ozone at a peak limit of 0.1 ppm (0.2 mg/m³)
It becomes advisory only

questions.questionText: According to the US EPA, what does ozone do to biological pollutants at concentrations that do not exceed public health standards?
options: It removes them completely within an hour
It does not effectively remove viruses, bacteria, mould or other biological pollutants
It removes mould from inside plasterboard
It is only effective against bacteria

questions.questionText: A client wants you to run an ozone machine for a musty smell. What should you do first?
options: Run the machine overnight with the family at home
Spray fragrance to cover it
Find and fix the moisture or mould source, then ventilate
Tell them ozone is TGA approved

questions.questionText: What did the 2021 Georgia Tech study measure while a hydroxyl radical generator ran in an office?
options: Nothing changed
Rises in oxygenated organic compounds, especially organic acids, and new secondary organic aerosol particles
A complete removal of all odours
A fall in particle levels to zero

questions.questionText: The TGA guidance lists ozone air sanitisers and deodorisers as excluded goods. What does that mean for you?
options: The TGA has approved them as safe and effective
They cannot be sold in Australia
The TGA does not assess them, and consumer law still applies to any claims you make about them
You can advertise them as killing all viruses

questions.questionText: When can someone go back into a room after an ozone treatment?
options: As soon as the machine is switched off
After a calibrated meter shows the reading is below the 0.1 ppm peak limit, after ventilating
When the smell of ozone has faded
After 10 minutes, whatever the reading

questions.questionText: A sales rep tells you a hydroxyl unit is safe to run with people at home. What is the right response?
options: Accept it, they know the product
Ask for the independent test report, including measured ozone output and by-products
Run it and see if anyone complains
Repeat the claim to your client
